a.lede: Illicit software on the computers of some of the world’s best online poker players allowed the accused cheater to see what cards were in the victims’ hands—and trounce them at the tables.
a.title: A Hacker Targeted High-Stakes Poker Players With Malware That Exposed Their Cards

b.lede: Wired has the story of a superuser cheating scandal.
b.title: Hacker may have stolen millions in a malware attack against online poker players
